editorial:
Imagine two people who just don't fit in with anyone else, and then they find each other. That is exactly what you get with Alice and Eddie. They are both political activists who spend their time fighting for things they believe in, but they often feel like outsiders in their own world. The vibe here is a sweet mix of funny arguments and heartfelt moments. You will feel like you are hanging out with a couple that is trying to change the world while barely figuring out how to handle their own messy lives. It is a charming look at love and rebellion that feels very real.

What really works here is the chemistry between the lead actors. They make the banter feel natural and the emotional scenes feel honest. The pacing is a bit slow at times, but that just adds to the relaxed, indie feel of the story. If you enjoy movies about quirky people finding love, you should definitely give this one a try.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with Alice and Eddie realizing that while they cannot fix every political problem in the world, they can support each other. After a series of loud arguments and failed protests, they decide to stop fighting the system alone. They choose to prioritize their relationship over their egos. The final scene shows them together, finally at peace with their misfit status and happy to face the future as a team.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about odd couples and political dreamers.
